question_text: Write the molecular formula of the first two members of the homologous series having functional group -Cl.
explanation: The general formula for the homologous series of a functional group -Cl is CnH2n+1Cl. For n=1, it's CH3Cl and for n=2, it's C2H5Cl.

question_text: Name the method by which Spirogyra reproduces under favorable conditions. Is this method sexual or asexual?
explanation: Under favorable conditions, Spirogyra reproduces by fragmentation, which is an asexual method.

question_text: An object is placed at a distance of 30 cm in front of a convex mirror of focal length 15 cm. Which of the following describes the image formed?
explanation: Using the mirror formula (1/v + 1/u = 1/f), with u = -30 cm and f = 15 cm, we find v = 10 cm. Since v is positive, the image is virtual. Magnification (m = -v/u) is positive and less than 1, so the image is erect and diminished.

question_text: What is sustainable management? Which of the following is the best reason why reuse is considered better than recycle?

options.label: A
options.text: Recycling consumes more energy than reuse.

options.label: B
options.text: Recycling creates more waste than reuse.

options.label: C
options.text: Reuse requires breaking down the original product.

options.label: D
options.text: Recycling is more expensive than reuse.

explanation: Sustainable management aims to conserve resources and use them efficiently. Reuse is better than recycling because recycling requires energy-intensive processes to reprocess the material, while reuse avoids these processes.

question_text: Management of forest and wildlife resources is a very challenging task. Which of the following is a reason for this?

options.label: B
options.text: There are many stakeholders with conflicting interests.

options.label: C
options.text: Wildlife is not important for the ecosystem.

options.label: D
options.text: The government is the only stakeholder.

explanation: Managing forests and wildlife is challenging because many stakeholders (local communities, industries, conservationists, etc.) have different and often conflicting interests.

question_text: Two carbon compounds X and Y have the molecular formula C4H8 and C5H12 respectively. Which one of these is most likely to show addition reaction?

options.label: A
options.text: X (C4H8) because it is a saturated hydrocarbon.

options.label: B
options.text: Y (C5H12) because it is an unsaturated hydrocarbon.

options.label: C
options.text: X (C4H8) because it is an unsaturated hydrocarbon.

options.label: D
options.text: Y (C5H12) because it is a saturated hydrocarbon.

explanation: C4H8 is an alkene (unsaturated hydrocarbon) and will show addition reactions due to the presence of a double bond. C5H12 is an alkane (saturated hydrocarbon) and will not readily undergo addition reactions.

question_text: Which of the following correctly completes the chemical equation: FeSO4(s) --(heat)--> ?
explanation: The balanced equation for the thermal decomposition of ferrous sulfate is 2FeSO4(s) --(heat)--> Fe2O3(s) + SO2(g) + SO3(g).

question_text: What are the vertical columns and horizontal rows in the Modern Periodic Table called, respectively? How does the metallic character of elements vary on moving down a vertical column?
explanation: Vertical columns are called groups, and horizontal rows are called periods. Metallic character increases down a group because the outermost electrons are further from the nucleus and easier to lose.

question_text: An element P (atomic number 20) reacts with an element Q (atomic number 17) to form a compound. What is the nature of the bond formed?
explanation: Element P (atomic number 20) is Calcium and Q (atomic number 17) is Chlorine. Calcium loses 2 electrons to form Ca2+ and Chlorine gains one electron to form Cl-. Hence, an ionic bond is formed between them.
